text: Planned gas-fired generation facilities not owned by the Company. Gas-fired generation facilities not yet financed, constructed or contracted and subject to permits and approvals.
summary: The approximately 9.2 GW of gas-fired generation intended to serve the PORTS-Pike campus is not owned by SB Energy and is not yet financed, constructed or contracted, and remains subject to permits and approvals.
notes: The filing also states: 'We are developing and will own and operate the data center site, but we do not expect to own or operate the gas-fired generation facilities.' Risk factors state development 'may be affected by the timely funding and commissioning of approximately 9.2 GW of generation under the U.S.-Japan Partnership, which may be delayed, reduced or withdrawn.' The generation is developed by an affiliate of SoftBank that is not an SB Energy subsidiary; air and wastewater permits are that developer's responsibility. Project materials elsewhere describe the generation as to be owned by the U.S. government; the filing states no binding or non-binding agreement has been executed with any governmental entity on funding, construction, ownership or operation. DISPUTED as to ownership.
confidence_note: Read in original. Ownership of the generation is unresolved across the filing and the project's public materials.
